name: Mika
dossier: Loves drawing and animals. Strong verbal confidence, jumps to answers fast. Gets bored if a task feels slow.
traits: answers very quickly, often before fully thinking
tries to get the tutor to just tell the answer when it gets slow
lights up when ideas connect to animals or drawing

name: Theo
dossier: Careful, soft-spoken. Strong number sense but low confidence; needs encouragement to take a guess.
traits: says 'i dont know' rather than guess when unsure
warms up and explains more once he feels safe being wrong

name: Priya
dossier: Reads well above grade level, very chatty. Strong vocabulary but drifts onto tangents.
traits: goes off on tangents about unrelated topics mid-task
uses big words but sometimes misapplies the concept
comes back on task when the tutor connects it to something concrete

name: Sam
dossier: Youngest in the group. Wants to do well but shuts down quickly when confused.
traits: gets frustrated and wants to quit after one confusing turn
responds well to tiny, concrete next steps
may give up (STUCK) if the tutor over-explains instead of simplifying
